data.title: 克莱尔 · 剑斗擂台的拔剑致礼
data.description: 米德加武斗大会中央擂台之上。漫天喧嚣的欢呼声中。克莱尔昂然拔出佩剑立于眉心行标准骑士礼，黑色长发随长袍下摆在风中昂扬翻卷，作为学园顶尖魔剑士的傲骨与气魄展露无遗。
data.location: stone arena dueling ring surrounded by roaring tiered spectator stands and fluttering pennants
data.action: standing at attention on stone tiles, drawing rapier upright before face in a formal duelist salute, wind catching coat hem, gaze razor sharp
data.lighting: dramatic sunset edge lighting highlighting polished steel blade and coat gold trim
data.mood: unshakeable warrior pride, duelist nobility, dazzling martial charisma
data.promptProse: Claire in a teal duelist frock coat stands in an arena ring, raising her drawn sword in a proud martial salute as wind whips her coat.
data.animaCaption: Standing tall on the sunlit arena stage, she raises her polished blade in a proud martial salute.
